manual_notes: Client-type validation/claims, lifecycle hooks, shared single-use pre-token state and fail-closed revoke reads are implemented. The selected logout requirement limits Redis revoke TTL to remaining JWT validity, but logout passes only token ID and RevokeSession uses now plus a full refresh-token lifetime. That deliberate conservative fallback can outlast remaining validity, so the full selected temporal contract is not a strict completion example.

sources.observed_facts: Login requires clientType and documents the four allowed user-session types.
Validates client types, emits auth hooks, rejects revoke read failures; Logout calls RevokeSession without expiry, whose fallback uses current time plus full refresh TTL.
KV revoke store sets TTL to time.Until(expiresAt), thus preserving the caller-supplied fallback expiry.
Stores client type in a short-lived pre-token record; atomic increment claim prevents repeat consumption.
